rationale: The landing md/shared-typing.md#claim-shared.typing.field directly introduces shared.typing.field. Links pattern context, pos/neg and focus; defines the one direct-field-description operator. Compared inline notation, displayed rules/equations, and any code/table with the named dependencies. fieldDescription returns an existing empty description when the single-field path is negative, otherwise maps successful focus to an inhabited description. The cases distinguish unknown from empty, and shared focusing preserves the effective permission. Prerequisites are linked in the retained chapter; the selected body states this subject rather than asking the reader to find a definition elsewhere in a multipurpose chapter.
limitations: Author editorial self-review, not an independent review. Link extraction and byte-range validation do not prove the coverage or clarity judgment. Future notes remain nonnormative and this audit does not assert formal correspondence.
